From: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Jason Wu <jason@techflow.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — next steps & calendar options

Hi Jason —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood! Quick next steps to get you a live demo & playground: 

• Self-serve: you can jump straight into the sandbox and try a sample prompt set (no scheduling needed).
• Book a short intro: if you want a focused 20–30 minute walkthrough tailored to TechFlow’s use case, use the link below or reply with 2–3 times that work for you.

Calendar (30 min): https://cal.redwood.com/dev-30min

I’ve attached a one-pager that outlines the hands-on demo we usually run (what we cover and what to prepare). If you'd like a narrower 20-minute session to cover only inference economics and integration, reply and we’ll make it happen.

Attachment: redwood-quickstart.pdf (1 page)

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

P.S. If you prefer a member of our SDR team to schedule for you, I’m looping them in on replies so they can propose slots quickly.
From: Jason Wu <jason@techflow.io>
To: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — next steps & calendar options

Thanks, Rachel — appreciate the quick info.

We’d like a focused 20-minute walkthrough that covers: latency expectations, model compatibility with our existing transformer pipeline, and pricing for steady-state inference. My availability (PDT):

• Tue 10/7: 1:00–2:00pm
• Wed 10/8: 9:00–11:00am
• Thu 10/9: 3:00–4:30pm

If those don’t work, happy to take the Calendly link.
